Domain: Physical — Resource: Stamina — Specialty: Combo — Specialty Condition: Stance

Close-quarters martial combat, physical pressure, and momentum built through successful exchanges — armed fighting, unarmed combat, grappling, aggressive movement, and defensive weapon use.

Combo

Whenever you inflict at least 1 Damage with a Prowess Action or Reaction, gain 1 Combo (max 5, no more than 1 per Action/Reaction). Each Combo increases your Movement by 1 unit. Prowess cards may generate, check, preserve, spend, or convert Combo into payoffs. At the end of your Turn, lose 1 Combo if you dealt no Damage that Turn; you also lose 1 Combo whenever you suffer a non-Temporary Wound.

Expertises

  • Dueling
  • Berserking
  • Brawling
  • Grappling
  • Skirmishing
  • Reaving
  • Phalanx

Subtypes

  • Opener
  • Blitz
  • Finisher
  • Breaker
  • Guard
